versions.built_for: mod-api (Modding API 0.1; not yet a stable release)
versions.fallback: one artifact family (a Longshot mod folder) serves every Longshot release whose Modding API is 0.1: the mod probes has('capture.frame')/has('game.pause')/hideGameHud and degrades per subsystem; the feature floor is photo mode (free camera) with capture logged as a plan until the capture seam lands (see seams.md). NOTE: stable v3.2.0 (main branch, verified 2026-11-28) has no Modding API at all - no longshot/camera marker in its binary, no `Longshot.exe mod` builder; this mod loads only where API 0.1 ships. A mod written for API 0.2 would need its own api pin.
